title: Add streaming disconnect + timeout panels/alerts (region/model breakdowns, runbook links)
author: Allison Grant
description: Context: Support and SRE are seeing repeated escalations where customers report intermittent streaming disconnects and elevated timeouts, but Support lacks a fast way to confirm whether it’s regional/model-specific vs client-side. This PR adds standard dashboard panels + alerting for streaming disconnect rate and timeout rate, with consistent label dimensions (region, model, deployment_mode) and direct links to the v2 escalation playbook/known-issues runbooks. Changes include: (1) Grafana dashboard updates: new panels for streaming disconnect rate (per 1k streaming responses) and timeout rate (per 1k requests), plus breakdown tables by region and model family, and a top endpoints table for /v1/chat/completions and /v1/completions; (2) Prometheus recording rules to normalize the rates and reduce query cost; (3) alert rules: warning and page thresholds with burn-rate style evaluation windows to avoid flapping; (4) all panels and alerts include runbook_url annotations linking to the Confluence known-issues pages for streaming reconnect guidance and timeout troubleshooting; (5) documentation notes in this repo for label hygiene and recommended dashboards to link in Support escalations. Notes: The disconnect metric is based on edge/gateway counters emitted when the server terminates a streaming response before [DONE] is flushed; this is intentionally scoped to server-side disconnects (client-initiated closes are separately tracked). Timeouts are based on upstream request deadline exceeded (504 + internal timeout codes). Rollout: safe to deploy; no runtime changes. Please validate in staging with synthetic streaming runs and verify label cardinality stays bounded. Follow-ups: ENG-2843 will wire these links into incident-bot prompts; docs PR in redwood-docs will mirror the public-safe guidance separately.

conversation: Tomáš Novák (review): Alert thresholds feel aggressive for page. Can we bias toward warn unless it’s clearly server-side? Also please ensure we’re not paging on single-model spikes due to label cardinality.

Allison Grant (author): Good call. Updated to burn-rate style: page requires sustained breach (10m over threshold + 1h confirming window). Also added a “by model_family” aggregation panel and changed the alert to aggregate by region+deployment_mode first; model breakdown is in annotations only.

Rafael Mendes (review): Love the runbook_url. Can you ensure it points at the internal Confluence KB (not public docs) until PM-613 signs off? Also please add a panel that answers “is it us-east only?” quickly.
Allison Grant (author): Yup—runbook_url points to internal Confluence paths in RUNBOOK_LINKS.md. Added a region heatmap panel and moved it to the top of Streaming Health dashboard.
Owen Phillips (review): From Support perspective, can we add a “what to ask customer for” note? Especially request_id and sdk version. Even a link is fine.
Allison Grant (author): Added a short note in dashboards/README.md and an annotation in the top panels linking to the escalation required-fields page (Confluence).

Priya Shah (review): The disconnect definition matches what we’ve been validating in SUP-4921 (server-side closes before [DONE]). Please add a panel that separates gateway vs runtime disconnects if the labels exist.
Allison Grant (author): We have source="gateway"|"runtime" on the counter; added a stacked bar panel (disconnects by source) and a table of top models/regions for each source.
Miles Thornton (review): Heads up: incident-bot expects runbook_url annotation key exactly. You used runbook in one alert file. Please normalize.
Allison Grant (author): Fixed; all alerts now use runbook_url. Also added a tiny unit check in scripts to catch missing runbook_url on new alert rules.
Tomáš Novák (final): Looks good. Thanks for tightening paging hygiene and adding the longer evaluation window. Approved.
Rafael Mendes (final): Approved. Please post the new dashboard links in #support after merge so folks start using them in escalations.
release_notes:
- Added Grafana panels for streaming disconnect rate and timeout rate with region/model breakdowns
- Added Prometheus recording rules to standardize rate calculations
- Added warning/page alerts for streaming disconnects and timeouts with runbook_url annotations
- Documented label conventions and Support escalation usage guidance
